items.title: SBM Bank India plans 26% stake sale, appoints consultant
items.summary: SBM Bank India is considering selling a twenty-six percent stake to raise expansion funds. The bank has appointed a consultant and is currently at the Expression of Interest stage. The parent company recently infused seventy-five crore rupees and will provide more capital. SBM Bank India aims for significant credit growth and is strengthening its digital wealth offerings.

items.title: Crude surge, Fed rate fears drag Nifty lower
items.summary: Nifty 50 settled at 23,779, down 118 points or 0.50%, while the Sensex fell 382.62 points to 76,132.81

items.title: 360 One Group CEO Bhagat buys 1.3 lakh shares of Novartis India for Rs 22 cr
items.summary: Karan Bhagat acquired 1.3 lakh Novartis India shares for nearly Rs 22 crore. His firm Kyrush Investments sold an equal number of shares in the transaction. Novartis India also announced acquiring trademarks from Pfizer for Rs 1,250 crore. Earlier, Novartis AG agreed to sell its stake to a consortium. This deal excluded its innovative medicines business in the country.

items.title: Low India VIX signals complacency, markets vulnerable to shocks
items.summary: The unusual combination of a subdued volatility index and a weakening equity market is prompting analysts to warn against investor complacency

items.title: Top stocks in focus tomorrow: Investors must watch Adani Power, Swiggy, Shiprocket shares on Tuesday, 8 Sept | Triggers
items.summary: The Indian stock market continued its decline on September 7, with the Nifty 50 down 0.57% and the Sensex falling 0.5%. Technology stocks led the losses, while the pharma sector showed some resilience. Investors are advised to consult experts before making decisions.

items.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over next two years
items.summary: The cuts come as the carmaker struggles with Chinese competition, US tariffs, and the transition to electric vehicles.

items.title: US dollar reserve shift may be less widespread than headline figures suggest, NY Fed study finds
items.summary: The dollar’s share of global reserves has fallen, but a New York Fed study says the decline is concentrated among a few countries. Reserve shifts largely reflect individual needs, challenging claims of broad global dollar diversification.

items.title: Oil prices rise to 6-week high after Iran and U.S. trade blows, Saudi Aramco facilities reportedly hit
items.summary: Renewed attacks between the adversaries in the Iran war pushed oil prices up on Monday.

items.title: Women wellness start-up Nua raises $50 million Series C round led by Peak XV & Filter Capital
items.summary: The funds will be deployed towards its next phase of growth, with a focus on brand building, expanding its reach and distribution, and strengthening its R&D capabilities

items.title: Why Jaguar Land Rover has decided change is needed
items.summary: Job cuts come as JLR faces falling sales and intense Chinese competition while trying to switch to electric vehicles.

items.title: Jio Platforms said to target IPO in November, roadshows from next week
items.summary: Jio Platforms is targeting a November IPO in its discussions with banks, though deliberations are ongoing and details, including size, valuation and dates, could change.

items.title: Sebi extends deadline for angel funds to comply with accredited investor mandate
items.summary: SEBI has extended the accredited investor compliance deadline for existing Angel Funds to March 31, 2027. During the transition, these funds cannot offer investment opportunities to more than 200 non-accredited investors, while newer funds remain restricted to accredited investors.

items.title: AI penny stock under ₹10 hits 5% upper circuit as IndiaAI Mission boosts infrastructure demand
items.summary: Empower India Limited's shares hit a 5% upper circuit as the company expands into sustainable digital infrastructure to meet rising AI demand.

items.title: Siemens Energy India advances cleaner high-voltage grid infrastructure with its Blue portfolio
items.summary: Siemens Energy India has commissioned its first 145 kV sulfur hexafluoride-free circuit breaker in Goa, introducing its Blue high-voltage technology to India. The equipment uses clean air insulation and vacuum switching, eliminating SF₆ and other fluorinated greenhouse gases while supporting reliable transmission infrastructure and the power sector’s decarbonisation efforts.

items.title: KONE, TK Elevator seek CCI nod for India business merger after €29.4 billion global deal
items.summary: Global elevator giants KONE and TKE seek regulatory approval for their merger in India. This significant transaction, valued at over twenty-nine billion euros, is a major corporate event. KONE plans to acquire sole control over TKE, which operates in India. The companies face competition regulators over market overlaps in elevator services. Both firms are seeking approval for this substantial business combination.

items.title: Steamhouse India, Manika Plastech to raise ₹539 crore
items.summary: While Steamhouse price fixed at ₹77-81 a share, Manika Plastech’s offer was priced at ₹40-43 a share

items.title: NIIF onboards Gauravjit Singh as managing partner for capital formation
items.summary: Gauravjit brings nearly two decades of experience in raising institutional capital across global, India-focused and pan-Asian alternative investment strategies

items.title: Five-year fuel contract with Mauritius: IndianOil turns 25-year presence into strategic foothold
items.summary: India has signed a five-year fuel supply agreement with Mauritius under which IndianOil will meet the island’s entire import requirement of fuels, marking the first such long-term deal with a country outside South Asia and signalling India’s emergence as a trusted energy supplier in the Indian Ocean.

items.title: AB InBev invests Rs 200 crore in Rajasthan brewery as beer demand surges beyond big cities
items.summary: AB InBev India has invested about Rs 200 crore in a new brewery in Neemrana, Rajasthan, expanding capacity to meet rising beer demand across North and central India. The facility began operations in July and will serve markets including Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Jharkhand, amid stronger premium beer consumption.

items.title: Swiggy picks 3.2% stake in Udaan, sells B2B arm for ₹500 crore
items.summary: Swiggy will swap its entire holding in Lynk Logistics for shares in Udaan’s parent and separately invest ₹75 crore in the B2B platform, retaining exposure to India’s retail distribution opportunity.

items.title: RNFI Services gets RBI in-principle nod to operate as payment aggregator
items.summary: RNFI Services has received in-principle RBI authorisation to operate as a Payment Aggregator-Physical (PA-P), allowing it to expand into offline and in-store payments. The approval adds another regulated payments capability to its existing financial services portfolio, including money movement, mutual fund distribution, insurance broking and prepaid payment instruments.

items.title: Nirmala Sitharaman and IMF Deputy MD Nigel Clarke discuss India's economic outlook and global growth
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman met with IMF Deputy Managing Director Nigel Clarke on Monday. They reviewed India-IMF relations and acknowledged India's role in SARTTAC. Discussions covered India's growth trajectory and global economic changes. The IMF official highlighted India's economic performance and resilience amid global challenges. Clarke also praised government efforts in fiscal consolidation and economic support measures.

items.title: Pranav Constructions IPO Day 1: Subscribed 4.55x, NIIs lead demand
items.summary: The non-institutional investors’ portion was subscribed 7.66 times, while the retail investors’ quota received 4.94 times subscription

items.title: Newly listed metal stock Rajputana Stainless to be in focus on Tuesday after order win from Suzlon Energy
items.summary: Rajputana Stainless shares are under scrutiny after securing an order from Suzlon Energy for a 2.10 MW wind project in Gujarat, valued at ₹16.21 crore. This marks a significant development for the company since its IPO debut in March, with shares now trading 52% higher than their original price.

items.title: Muthoot FinCorp plans to raise up to ₹700 cr via NCD
items.summary: The non-convertible debentures (NCD) Tranche V will open on September 8 and close on September 22, 2026, subject to early closure upon necessary approvals

items.title: IIM Bangalore’s PGP jumps to No. 21 globally in FT MiM 2026, retains India’s top spot
items.summary: IIM Bangalore’s two-year PGP has climbed to 21st globally in the Financial Times Masters in Management 2026 ranking, up from 28th in 2025 and 41st in 2024. The institute retained its No. 1 position in India, with stronger career progression, salary outcomes, alumni network and value-for-money rankings.

items.title: PVR Inox shares close nearly 6% lower as kickback report compounds buyback sell-off
items.summary: Investors who purchased shares ahead of that date to participate in the buyback are now exiting positions, a pattern typical of post-record-date trading in buyback stocks

items.title: Greenland welcomes major funding boost from EU amid Trump’s annexation threats
items.summary: It comes shortly after Icelanders voted to reject restarting EU membership talks and as Trump renews his push to acquire Greenland on national security grounds.

items.title: Far-right AfD landslide in German state piles pressure on federal government
items.summary: The "extraordinary" result may be the "most consequential German state-election result of the postwar era," according to analysts.

items.title: First female administrator in the Panama Canals history takes the helm
items.summary: First female administrator in the Panama Canal's history takes the helm

items.title: Gold loans, consumer durables drive NBFC credit growth to 14.9% in July
items.summary: Non-banking financial companies saw 14.9 percent credit expansion by July end. This growth accelerated from last year's 10.6 percent expansion. Gold loans surged 68.5 percent and consumer durable loans grew 51.5 percent. Retail loans within NBFCs increased 21.4 percent, showing strong performance. Housing and vehicle loans also recorded significant year-on-year growth.

items.title: LPG refill booking interval cut from 45 to 25 days, says Union MoS Suresh Gopi
items.summary: The Centre has reduced the booking interval for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) refills from 45 days to 25 days, Union Minister of State for Petroleum and Natural Gas Suresh Gopi said on Monday. The revised 25-day booking interval will apply uniformly to LPG consumers in both urban and rural areas.

items.title: US Fed rate decision: What markets are watching ahead of September meeting
items.summary: Markets weigh a Fed rate hike after stronger-than-expected August jobs data, elevated oil prices and Middle East tensions, with Friday's inflation report seen as the key factor ahead of the September 15-16 FOMC meeting.

items.title: Chancellor refuses to rule out tax hikes in October Budget
items.summary: John Healey detailed plans to spread growth more widely across the UK, ahead of his first Budget.

items.title: SBI says bank unions to strike on September 11, September 28-30 and from October 26; operations may be hit
items.summary: State Bank of India on Monday said bank unions have served strike notices for September 11, September 28-30 and a continuous strike from October 26. SBI said it has made arrangements for normal functioning at branches and offices, but warned that work across the bank may nevertheless be impacted.

items.title: Mint Explainer | The post-Tim Cook Apple: Can John Ternus fill the big shoes?
items.summary: Straight off, Apple’s new head will have a few burning questions to address.

items.title: CII business confidence rebounds in Q2 on improving demand, hiring and investment outlook
items.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in Q2FY27, as stronger domestic demand, higher capacity utilization and easing cost pressures bolster the recovery outlook

items.title: Pranav Constructions IPO GMP Today: What latest rate hints at listing share price | Allotment, stock market debut date
items.summary: Pranav Constructions' IPO opened with a grey market premium of ₹44 per share, indicating strong demand. The public issue aims to raise ₹351 crore and is set to close on September 9. Investors are advised to apply for a minimum of 120 shares at a price band of ₹118-124.

items.title: CBIC releases import clearance checklist for cosmetics, drugs, and medical devices
items.summary: The CBIC has introduced a new checklist for customs officers reviewing imports. This standardized process aims to streamline clearances for drugs and medical devices. Businesses must upload all required documentation onto the e-SANCHIT portal. Industry experts welcome the shift towards a more transparent digital verification.

items.title: Spain mandates new 20-year green bond syndication, seeks to raise €4 billion
items.summary: Spain has announced a new initiative requiring banks to participate in a syndicated 20-year green government bond, aimed at generating about four billion euros soon. Leading financial institutions such as Barclays, BBVA, Credit Agricole CIB, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and Santander will manage the offering. Additional primary dealers will be welcomed in the syndication while the funds raised will align with Spain's refreshed Green Bond Framework.

items.title: Indian bonds end flat as traders gauge RBI liquidity approach
items.summary: In a cautious trading session, Indian government bonds experienced little movement as the Reserve Bank of India implemented temporary liquidity management strategies. By withdrawing substantial amounts through variable rate reverse repos, the central bank aimed to counterbalance the influx from sizeable diaspora deposits. Additionally, the pressure from rising oil prices kept bond prices from gaining traction, although overnight indexed swap rates registered slight decreases throughout the day.

items.title: SpaceX rival launches rocket in historic first, says industry is 'desperate' for more
items.summary: Isar Aerospace reached orbit on its second test flight as the German rocket startup looks to scale production amid booming satellite launch demand.

items.title: Party's over for crypto scammers who went on a spending spree after a $240 million bitcoin theft
items.summary: In a bold social engineering heist, young con artists pilfered over $240 million in bitcoin, leading to an extravagant month of luxury splurges, complete with stylish mansions. The FBI has arrested Malone Lam, alleged leader of the gang, alongside 17 others, underscoring a disturbing trend of cryptocurrency frauds reported to them. With rising criminal activity, law enforcement is intensifying efforts to prosecute these offenders and reclaim the misappropriated assets.

items.title: Sachin Tendulkar buys 3.86-acre land parcel in Lonavala
items.summary: Cricketer Sachin Tendulkar has acquired over 3.9 acres of land in Lonavala for a combined ₹70 crore through three registered transactions. The parcels, spanning 15,601.78 sq m, include an existing built-up structure. Tendulkar paid about ₹4.20 crore in stamp duty, according to registration documents accessed through Zapkey.

items.title: Tech glitch or weak demand? Conflicting claims emerge as RBI launches another liquidity withdrawal op; check details
items.summary: The RBI is set to conduct a ₹5 trillion VRRR auction on 7 September, following a disappointing longer-tenor auction that saw only ₹2.59 trillion offered.

items.title: SEBI eases regulatory compliance for FPIs investing only in government securities | Details here
items.summary: Indian capital market regulator Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has reduced the regulatory compliance for all foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) investing exclusively in government securities (G-Secs).

items.title: Vodafone Idea among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 22% in a month
items.summary: Despite a 382-point fall in the Sensex, four stocks from the BSE 200 index, Vodafone Idea, Lenskart Solutions, Solar Industries India and Divi's Laboratories hit fresh 52-week highs on Monday. Key gainers Vodafone Idea and Lenskart led the rally, each rising up to 22% over the past month.

items.title: Trump says he's made 'Hundreds of Billions of Dollars on Stocks' for the U.S., in stream of AI posts
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a stream of AI-generated images and a series of sweeping and unverified claims on Truth Social on Sunday

items.title: Sebi eases compliance norms for FPIs investing only in government securities
items.summary: Sebi has eased compliance requirements for FPIs investing exclusively in government securities, removing the need to furnish investor group details. The move follows the RBI’s decision to withdraw concentration limits for such FPIs under the General Route.

items.title: Sebi eases compliance for foreign investors investing in government bonds
items.summary: The relaxation removes the need for FPIs investing only in G-Secs to furnish investor group details.

items.title: US shale pioneer takes fracking to Australia’s remote gas frontier
items.summary: American producers hope to export practices around the world as countries seek new supplies due to the Iran war

items.title: PVR INOX says preliminary probe found no evidence of kickbacks, disputes account of senior executive’s exit
items.summary: PVR INOX on Monday said a preliminary assessment into anonymous allegations of employee impropriety found no evidence of kickbacks, countering reports of an alleged ₹200-crore scandal. The company also clarified that former senior executive Pramod Arora resigned for personal reasons on May 4 and was not asked to leave.

items.title: HEG demerger news | Stock zooms 5% on record date — what's next for investors?
items.summary: HEG's demerger creates two entities: HEG Graphite and HEG Advanced Materials. Each shareholder receives a share in HEG Graphite for every HEG share held. Emkay assesses a combined value of over ₹18,000 crore post-demerger, indicating a 30% value unlock.

items.title: HRV Pharma bets ₹150 crore on peptides, high-potency oncology APIs
items.summary: The investments mark a shift in HRV’s seven-year-old business model—from using available manufacturing capacity to underwriting specialised capacity for products it owns and commercializes

items.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over two years in major cost-saving drive
items.summary: The luxury carmaker is targeting £1.7 billion ($2.3 billion) in savings as it faces Chinese competition, a cyberattack and U.S. tariffs.

items.title: India's growth seen above 7% in FY27 as investment, exports take centre stage: Report
items.summary: India's economic growth is expected to exceed seven percent in fiscal year twenty twenty-seven. Investment and export cycles will increasingly offset moderating consumption trends. Corporate capital expenditure is projected to strengthen significantly in the coming years. Elevated global commodity prices may keep interest rates higher for longer periods. The Reserve Bank of India might shift towards tightening monetary policy.

items.title: Arnya, IPO-bound Casagrand form ₹750 cr south India-focused residential platform
items.summary: Arnya Real Estate Fund III-Preferred Capital, a Category II alternative investment fund, will invest in around 8-10 projects in Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

items.title: When Nithin Kamath met Karthik Rangappa: The journey from international investor account sales pitch to heading Varsity
items.summary: Zerodha co-founder Nithin Kamath credited Karthik Rangappa as central to building Zerodha Varsity, the brokerage’s free financial education platform. Kamath highlighted Rangappa’s long association, continued contribution and role in expanding Varsity, stressing education rather than customer acquisition as its core purpose.

items.title: IndiGo to start direct Guwahati-Bangkok flights from October 27
items.summary: IndiGo will launch twice-weekly non-stop flights between Guwahati and Bangkok from October 27, marking its first international operations from Guwahati. The route will give Northeast India direct connectivity to Thailand and strengthen Guwahati’s position as a gateway to Southeast Asia.

items.title: Air India’s new CEO says he’ll ‘make Air India great again’
items.summary: New Air India chief executive Tewolde Gebremariam emphasizes operational excellence and safety during an employee townhall.

items.title: Private Credit vs Fixed Income: What HNIs need to know before investing
items.summary: ET Alpha Summit 2.0 will bring together leading investment voices to discuss private credit, structured debt and evolving portfolio strategies. As HNIs look beyond traditional fixed income for income and diversification, the summit will explore the opportunities, risks and role of private credit in today's portfolios, with insights from industry leaders.

items.title: Air India gets a new boss, but Tewolde Gebremariam isn’t officially CEO yet: Here’s why
items.summary: Tewolde Gebremariam is set to take charge of Air India following Campbell Wilson’s departure, though his formal appointment awaits MHA security clearance. The former Ethiopian Airlines chief said safety and operational excellence will be his top priorities.

items.title: Market wrap: L&T, Bharti Airtel, Infosys, Tech Mahindra top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
items.summary: Indian markets ended lower on Monday, with Sensex and Nifty falling 0.5% each as elevated crude oil prices and geopolitical uncertainty weighed on sentiment. IT and media stocks faced heavy selling, while pharma and healthcare outperformed. Infosys, SBI Life and HDFC Life were among the top losers.

items.title: Over 100% returns in 6 months | Multibagger defence stock hits 52-week high ahead of board meeting to discuss fundraise
items.summary: Raymond shares have delivered strong multibagger returns of 103% over the last six months, defying weak stock market trends. The stock hit a 52-week low of ₹320.40 on 30 March this year, and at the current juncture, it is up 141% from its 52-week low.

items.title: Quote of the day by Charles Ellis: "Only novel “soft-shelled” ideas produce extraordinary returns, because the obvious ideas are already reflected in a stock’s price."
items.summary: Charles Ellis argues that extraordinary investment returns are more likely to come from overlooked, unconventional ideas than widely known opportunities. Investors should independently assess emerging trends, fundamentals and mispriced stocks, while balancing contrarian thinking with patience, valuation discipline and risk analysis.

items.title: RBL Bank to raise up to USD 1 bn from overseas investors
items.summary: RBL Bank's board has given the green light to raise up to one billion US dollars from foreign investors via a Euro Medium Term Note Programme. The bank's borrowing committee is entrusted with overseeing all vital steps required for this initiative. This decision comes on the heels of Emirates NBD Bank acquiring a controlling sixty percent stake in RBL Bank's enhanced share capital.

items.title: Bank of Maharashtra, Canara Bank eye dollar debt issuance this month, bankers say
items.summary: Canara Bank and Bank of Maharashtra will raise $500 million each through dollar bonds. These lenders will issue three-year or five-year papers under a concessional swap window. This move aims to lower the cost of hedging currency exchange rate risks. Bank of Maharashtra is making its debut issuance, while Canara Bank has issued before. Both debt sales are anticipated to be completed during the month of September.

items.title: Upstox launches US stocks investing, offers access to 8,000 stocks, 2,000 ETFs
items.summary: The offering includes stocks of major global companies such as Apple, Tesla, Amazon and Google

items.summary: 22, 24 carat Gold prices down across metro cities on September 7

items.summary: Arnya Realestates and Casagrand Premier Builder plan to raise over Rs 750 crore through a Category II AIF focused on residential real estate in Chennai, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. The fund will invest Rs 75-200 crore across 8-10 projects, offering institutional investors exposure through a preferred equity investment structure.

items.summary: Jizan, near the Yemeni border, has been repeatedly targeted by Houthi rebels in their campaign against Saudi Arabia

items.title: 52% apparel makers expect higher festive sales, CMAI survey finds
items.summary: Indian apparel makers expect higher festive sales this year. Many members anticipate matching last year's sales performance. Rising raw material costs are a significant concern for businesses. Indian wear and western casuals are predicted to lead growth.

items.title: Swiggy launches dedicated food safety helpline, in-app channel for customers to report order-related concerns
items.summary: Swiggy has introduced a dedicated helpline and an in-app channel for food safety concerns. Customers can now report issues by calling a specific number or using the new help section. This initiative aims to enhance customer feedback and address potential food safety gaps effectively. The company will review complaints on priority and take necessary actions promptly. These measures align with increased attention to food safety regulations across India.

items.title: Purple Style Labs end 1% below ₹575-IPO price after 6-7% discount debut
items.summary: On the NSE, the stock debutes at ₹535, a discount of 6.9% to the IPO price; on the BSE, it listed at ₹539, down 6.2%

items.title: Rupee falls 7 paise to close at 94.50 against US dollar
items.summary: During the day, the local unit touched an intraday high of 94.38 and a low of 94.50

items.title: Gold Prediction: Will Gold prices fall further? Experts reveal key levels for investors to watch
items.summary: Gold prices fell 0.7% today as positive US jobs data increased rate hike expectations. While geopolitical tensions and high oil prices provide counterbalance, upcoming inflation readings are crucial in determining the market's trend for precious metals amid rising interest rates.

items.title: Alternative fuels overtake petrol in India’s car sales for first time as CNG, EVs and hybrids gain ground
items.summary: In response to soaring fuel costs, consumers are now leaning towards alternative fuels like CNG, hybrids, and electric vehicles, resulting in a decline in petrol sales. Rural markets have played a pivotal role in driving year-on-year vehicle registration growth. Electric vehicle adoption is steadily climbing across different segments. While dealers remain hopeful for strong demand, they are wary of monsoon-related challenges and possible increasing prices.

items.title: Tata Motors’ Jaguar Land Rover aims to reduce costs by ₹21,700 crore by laying off 4,000 jobs
items.summary: Jaguar Land Rover plans to cut up to 4,000 jobs in the UK due to falling sales, American tariffs and competition. The UK government has refused financial aid.

items.title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex, Nifty decline 0.50%; Infosys, Tech Mahindra lead losses
items.summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Indian benchmark indices extended their decline on Monday as investors remained cautious amid elevated crude prices and geopolitical uncertainty, with selling pressure pushing the Sensex to an intraday low below 76,000.

items.summary: An Amazon.com Inc. cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, shutting down the airport’s runways and taxiways and prompting an emergency response.

items.title: RBI's liquidity test may set future course
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is currently grappling with a notable liquidity dilemma due to a surge in FCNR(B) scheme inflows. To navigate this, a pivotal variable rate reverse repo auction is set to influence the liquidity management strategy. The central bank may also utilize measures such as dollar swaps and bond sales.

items.title: Govt mandates manual verification of imported drugs and medical devices due to SWIFT 2.0 system gap
items.summary: Customs officers must now manually check import documents for healthcare products. This manual verification applies even to facilitated imports cleared by the risk system. The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs issued this directive on September third. A gap in the SWIFT 2.0 digital system necessitates this manual document check. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation requested this action to ensure regulatory compliance.

items.title: Finmin secures $1 billion IFC funding for MSMEs; $500 million already released to Sidbi
items.summary: India secured one billion dollars from the International Finance Corporation for banks. This funding will provide long-term credit to small businesses and financial institutions. The facility will address a key gap by offering loans of up to seven years. It aims to galvanize MSME capital expenditure investment and support modernization.

items.title: Taj at Delhi Airport, Ritz-Carlton in Hyderabad: Inside Chalet Hotels’ expansion plan to reach 5,500 rooms by FY30
items.summary: Chalet Hotels Ltd aims to reach 5,500 hotel keys by FY30, transitioning from a pure asset-ownership model to include third-party and franchise operations while focusing on the Athiva brand and maintaining its hospitality-first approach.

items.title: SEC sues ISS as Trump administration ramps up scrutiny of proxy advisers
items.summary: The SEC sued Institutional Shareholder Services to enforce a subpoena as the Trump administration increases scrutiny of influential proxy advisers.

items.title: 'Speculative and factually incorrect': NSE denies Ashishkumar Chauhan being considered for Tata Sons chairman post
items.summary: NSE has denied reports that its MD and CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan is being considered for the Tata Sons chairman post. Chauhan called the reports entirely baseless and said he remains focused on NSE’s planned IPO and his responsibilities at the exchange.

items.title: GST Council meeting postponed to 7 October from 12 September
items.summary: The preparatory meetings of government officers will now be held on 5 October from 3pm and on 6 October from 11am onwards, ahead of the GST Council meeting on 7 October.

items.title: Mint Explainer | Why the era of cheap money is ending
items.summary: Moody’s Ratings, in a recent report, said a new macroeconomic regime is driving differentiated repricing across financial assets, and at the heart of this shift is a move towards higher interest rates.

items.title: Sugar is outperforming the stock market this year. Here's what's driving it, and where it can go from here
items.summary: The sweetener's prices surged last week, reflecting a sharp deterioration in the global supply outlook.

items.title: NCR's gourmet grocer Modern Bazaar halves store count amid q-comm push, internal woes
items.summary: Modern Bazaar, a gourmet grocery retailer in Delhi-NCR, is downsizing its store network due to the rise of quick commerce, and deepening financial and management trouble. While restructuring for profitability, the chain aims to adapt to changing consumer preferences without exiting physical retail.

items.title: RPG Life Sciences bets on China-plus 1, goes on an API buying spree
items.summary: The Harsh Goenka group is spending to build a drug-ingredients business, betting that the world's push to rely less on China will favour Indian makers.

items.title: ‘Model fatigue’ sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions at frenetic pace
items.summary: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Google all released model updates this week, while Nvidia said it's acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face.

items.title: AI fears have faded, but auditors must retain human edge: IFAC's top executives
items.summary: The IFAC's top executives call for rapid tech adoption without compromising professional scepticism and ethics.

items.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled: BRICS Summit clash pushes 57th meet to October 7
items.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting, scheduled for September 12 has been rescheduled due to a clash with the BRICS Summit in New Delhi. The meeting is expected to discuss pending GST issues, including ITC, corporate guarantees and rate rationalisation.

items.title: UK business minister to meet Jaguar Land Rover CEO over job cuts
items.summary: JAGUAR LAND ROVER-REDUNDANCIES/ (PIX):UK business minister to meet Jaguar Land Rover CEO over job cuts

items.title: Smaller economy, PPI inclusion: Why India’s GDP is facing fresh scrutiny
items.summary: India's updated gross domestic product methodology addresses past statistical issues, but downward nominal revisions and the sudden inclusion of the Producer Price Index raise credibility concerns.

items.title: Engineering goods exporters seek mandate on carbon emission certificate under EU norms
items.summary: Engineering exporters have urged the government to mandate accredited carbon-emission data from raw-material suppliers, warning that small exporters could struggle to meet EU requirements under the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). About 70% of India’s engineering exports to the EU come from MSMEs.

items.title: Govt mulls FDI liberalisation in plantation sector
items.summary: India is considering liberalizing foreign direct investment norms for plantations. More commercial crops like bananas could be included under this policy. The government aims to boost exports of bananas significantly in coming years. This move seeks to enhance India's global market share in banana production. Stakeholder consultations are currently underway for this proposed policy change.

items.title: GST Council meeting likely to be postponed, say sources
items.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting, scheduled for September 12, is likely to be postponed, with a final decision expected after consultations with states. The meeting was set to discuss several ease-of-doing-business measures, including protecting buyers’ ITC when suppliers fail to deposit GST, simplifying taxation of corporate guarantees, allowing ITC on certain employee-related expenses and enabling small businesses to obtain GST registrations across multiple states.

items.title: India emerges as key diesel supplier to Europe as Russian, US flows falter
items.summary: India now supplies sixty percent of diesel transiting Bab-el-Mandeb to Europe. Russian diesel exports remain severely constrained due to ongoing disruptions. US shipments to Europe have also begun to weaken significantly. Indian refineries are filling a crucial gap in Europe's eastern diesel supply.

items.summary: Better give start-ups reasons to stay than make it harder to leave

items.title: Russian gold floods through Hong Kong in wake of western sanctions
items.summary: Shipments hit record high with almost 100 tonnes imported from Russia in first seven months of this year

items.summary: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?

items.summary: LeBron James on Saturday teased an upcoming partnership with the prediction markets platform Polymarket in a social media post.

items.summary: Ten days ahead of the next Federal Reserve meeting, the Trump administration looks to be in a full-court press to halt a rate hike in its tracks.

items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi made the appeal on September 1 in a video posted on Instagram from the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek, linking domestic spending choices with India's goal of becoming a developed economy by 2047.

items.title: Trump wants rate cuts to unleash 15% growth, but economists warn cash influx could worsen inflation | Explained
items.summary: President Trump pressures the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, arguing that doing so could spur unprecedented economic growth. However, economists warn that this may reignite inflation
